# NITA Gallery

> NITA Gallery is an art gallery at 68 Campbell Street, Surry Hills, Sydney NSW 2010, Australia. It shows abstract paintings by Ritushka,
> fine-art photography by Nick Brand Photography, wearable art (scarves and sarongs) by the Nikki B label, and a cabinet of jewellery.

## Visit
- Address: 68 Campbell Street, Surry Hills NSW 2010
- Opening hours: Tuesday and Wednesday 10am-6pm; Thursday 10am-8pm; Friday 10am-6pm; Saturday 10am-3pm; closed Sunday and Monday
- Parking is difficult nearby; a train is suggested, and there is a car park across the road.
- Email: studio@nickbrandphotography.com
- Map: https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=68+Campbell+Street+Surry+Hills+NSW+2010

## Prices (Australian dollars)
- Ritushka original paintings (available works): A$1,450 to A$5,250, framed
- Nick Brand Photography Bodyscapes limited editions (edition of 15): from AUD 1,900 framed
- Nikki B scarves and sarongs (100% Modal, 100 x 200 cm): AUD $120
- Jewellery: AUD $75 to AUD $207
